I've been searching for something like this for a while and I couldn't be happier about this find! First of all, it is extremely sturdy and well built, after assembly, it truly feels like it is one piece. Second of all, the height adjustability is great if you have a low ceiling (like me😆), but if you do have high enough ceiling (and you're average height or shorter) you'll be able to hang with straight legs! Also, it can be great for kids because it can go low. Third of all, the H structure and the wide frame helps a lot, because unlike other stations where you have a support bar in the middle which you bump your thighs and knees (I had one like that, it was so annoying), this one is completely clear throughout, making the exercises much more pleasant to do. Also, the packaging was incredible, every piece had its own warping so that nothing would get scratched and the instructions are simple and easy to follow. Overall, I like it very much, great price, was delivered in less than 48 hours after placing order. Thank you so much VEVOR! ‹NAMN›.
Overall everything's alright, seems a little wobbly at Height adjustment points if your doing explosive moves, if you planning to adjust height frequently it I'll be a pain.

Once assembled, it's somewhat difficult to adjust the height, the supports seem very tight and the arms don't raise evenly or smoothly at all. I may try to loosen some of the bolts to see if I can get it to move more easily. Holds my weight (~205 lbs) with no issues, but does rock forward and backwards and tipped over when I was hanging from it

I was very impressed with the quality and craftmanship... not just the furniture itself, but also how it was packaged so meticulously. It was remarkable to open the box and see all the pieces so carefully wrapped and cushioned. It is clear that a lot of effort and consideration went into the process. The instructions were very user-friendly and building the shoe cabinet was straightforward. The final result is better than anticipated and this product will suit our needs very well. Highly recommended!
